operation.source_intent: Start a real server-created PayPal subscription checkout for the selected commercially configured plan and navigate to the provider approval URL; browser return is navigation only and never payment evidence.

laravel_runtime.provider_boundary: BillingProvider::createSubscriptionIntent via the existing provider registry

security.tenant_selector: server-owned auth + tenant.context; foreign tenant membership fails closed
security.plan_selector: caller may submit only bounded plan_code; tenant_id, user_id, subscription/provider identifiers and extra request keys are rejected
security.authorization: billing.manage is required server-side for checkout; billing.view controls the account surface
security.idempotency: tenant-scoped IdempotencyService binds key + canonical operation + plan_code and replays the stored checkout response without a second provider intent
security.provider_identity: provider and provider subscription identity are resolved and persisted server-side and are never accepted from the browser
security.provider_secret_policy: provider subscription identity is never returned to the browser; only the approval URL and pending-provider-confirmation state are exposed
security.redirect_policy: frontend accepts only an HTTPS approval URL returned by the authenticated Laravel checkout endpoint
security.payment_truth: browser return/cancel navigation is not treated as payment success; provider reconciliation remains authoritative
security.csrf: mutation uses the Laravel web/auth/tenant.context route stack and apiRequest supplies the CSRF token when present

coverage: exact canonical operation identity on production UI and Laravel route
same-key replay creates no second provider checkout intent
provider subscription identity is not exposed
HTTPS provider navigation only after successful server checkout
current paid subscription checkout is fail-closed in favor of plan change
